Frontend UI loads and full extract flow works end-to-end; translate flow surfaces 'Translation failed' toast + ERROR status in terminal.

action_items: Investigate Gemini 3.1 Pro model id 'gemini-3.1-pro-preview' with EMERGENT_LLM_KEY via emergentintegrations — upstream returns connection termination. Consider (a) verifying the exact supported model id (e.g. 'gemini-2.5-pro' / current Emergent-supported Gemini id) or (b) adding a retry/backoff + graceful fallback in _translate_batch so the whole request doesn't 500. Currently a single upstream hiccup fails the entire translate call and breaks the patch-mode UX.
